Method.name: ProcessHttpsRequest

#dim tSC As %Status=$$$OK $$$TRACE("Inside Method ProcessHttpsRequest")
Set httprequest=##class(%Net.HttpRequest).%New()
$$$TRACE("Adapter.HTTPServer: "_..Adapter.HTTPServer) $$$TRACE("Adapter.HTTPPort: "_..Adapter.HTTPPort) $$$TRACE("Adapter.URL: "_..Adapter.URL) $$$TRACE("Adapter.SSLConfig: "_..Adapter.SSLConfig) $$$TRACE("Adapter.ResponseTimeout: "_..Adapter.ResponseTimeout) $$$TRACE("Adapter.ConnectTimeout: "_..Adapter.ConnectTimeout) $$$TRACE("Adapter.WriteTimeout: "_..Adapter.WriteTimeout)
$$$TRACE("Setting form data...") $$$TRACE("Facility Code: "_pRequest.FacilityCode) $$$TRACE("Sender ID: "_pRequest.SenderID) $$$TRACE("ReceiverID: "_pRequest.ReceiverID) $$$TRACE("Input Source: "_pRequest.InputSource) $$$TRACE("Source File Name: "_pRequest.SourceFileName) $$$TRACE("Destination File Name: "_pRequest.DestinationFileName) $$$TRACE("Destination File Path: "_pRequest.DestinationFilePath) $$$TRACE("Claim Data:"_pRequest.ClaimData)

$$$TRACE("JSONString: "_JSONString)
set tStream = ##class(%Stream.GlobalCharacter).%New("") do tStream.Write(JSONString)
Set httprequest.ContentType="application/json" set url = ..Adapter.URL $$$TRACE("Adapter.URL: "_..Adapter.URL)
Do httprequest.EntityBody.Write() ; do httprequest.EntityBody.CopyFrom(tStream) do httprequest.InsertFormData("inputsource",pRequest.InputSource) do httprequest.InsertFormData("sourcefilename",pRequest.SourceFileName) do httprequest.InsertFormData("destinationfilename",pRequest.DestinationFileName) do httprequest.InsertFormData("destinationfilePath",pRequest.DestinationFilePath) do httprequest.InsertFormData("facilitycode",pRequest.FacilityCode) do httprequest.InsertFormData("claimData",JSONString)
try { $$$TRACE("POSTing to "_..Adapter.HTTPServer_":"_..Adapter.HTTPPort_"/"_..Adapter.URL) set postStatus = httprequest.Post(..Adapter.HTTPServer_":"_..Adapter.HTTPPort_"/"_..Adapter.URL) set tHttpResponse=httprequest.HttpResponse $$$TRACE("StatusLine: "_tHttpResponse.StatusLine) set tSC = postStatus $$$TRACE("Data successfully posted to Edifecs.") } catch eException { set errTxt = $System.Status.GetErrorText(%objlasterror) $$$LOGERROR("Exception in insert data to Oracle tables: " _errTxt) set tSC = $$$ERROR($$$NotConnectedError, "Unable to connect with DB, " _ eException) } quit tSC
